The ill-conceived US war on Iran is leading the world to a global recession or depression. Professor Richard Wolff places the current crisis in the context of the capitalist system and the decline of US hegemonic power on the latest episode of CHR.

Link: piped.video/watch?v=sv61bqSe…

Throughout its long war on Iran, every tactic used by the United States has backfired. Professor Behrooz Ghamari-Tabrizi explains why Iran’s revolutionary spirit remains strong on the latest episode of The Chris Hedges Report. 

Link: piped.video/watch?v=i5rlfQ0G…

"Former University of Pittsburgh student Muhammad Ali faces three felonies for a brief tug-of-war with an officer over a metal barrier." 

Ali is being made an example for his participation in anti-genocide protests. Sign the petition (next tweet) to drop the charges against him. 

dropsitenews.com/p/palestine…

.@normfinkelstein has recently taken issue with the characterization by figures like Tucker Carlson and Candace Owens of the Trump-Israeli relationship primarily being driven by "blackmail." On my last Q&A, I briefly broke down the complexities of how Israel exerts influence on the American political system, primarily via legalized bribery (but still including blackmail).

Video
Watch my full Q&A on Iran on YouTube: piped.video/watch?v=HDSeOPAh…

Will the U.S. withdraw from the Middle East? Perhaps — but not voluntarily. Iran has shown to the world the weak points in the Empire's seemingly hegemonic presence in the region. If exploited successfully by its adversaries, we could the dollar cease to be the world reserve currency, tanking America's global standing.

Video

Trump’s portrayal of himself as Jesus, or anointed by Jesus, is typical of cult leaders.

Watch Eunice Wong's reading of my column, "Trump the God" on YouTube now:
piped.video/watch?v=BKRcQm9H…

With Zionist pressure pushing Trump to escalate on one side, and catastrophic economic consequences pressuring him into a deal on the other — can the Iran War end smoothly? John Mearsheimer and I discuss on the latest episode of The Chris Hedges Report. 

Link: piped.video/watch?v=GMg6_jGf…
Join me on on May 1st, 2026, at Witherspoon St. Presbyterian Church in Princeton, NJ. Use the QR code below to sing up.

Journalist Laith Marouf places the new ceasefire in Lebanon in the context of the rise of the Axis of Resistance, the new multipolar world and the end of Western hegemony. Watch now on the latest episode of CHR.

Link: piped.video/watch?v=oA3k4eIj…
Chris Hedges LIVE Q&A: The Iran War & the Fall of the American Empire nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1mxPaLpzM…

We will be live in one hour at 7pm ET...
piped.video/watch?v=HDSeOPAh…

Join me for a livestream Q&A tonight at 7:00pm ET where we will discuss the war in Iran and the fall of the American Empire. 

Link: piped.video/watch?v=HDSeOPAh…

.@medeabenjamin explains one of the primary reasons Cuba, a tiny island with a population of 10 million people, has long threatened the U.S.; it once served as a good example of an alternative to our profit-driven, capitalist system.

Video

Alastair Crooke breaks down the global success of Iran — inspiring people not only in the region, but in Russia and China as well.

Video

The US economic strangulation of Cuba has created unbearable hardships for the population. @medeabenjamin  dscribes what she saw on a recent solidarity delegation and how we can break the blockade. Watch now on The Chris Hedges Report.

Link: piped.video/watch?v=JzWMouhv…

This article was originally published at my Substack. To continue my independent journalism, I depend on the generosity and support of my readers. If you'd like to support me directly, you can do so at my Substack: chrishedges.substack.com Thank you for all your support.
